solid_pages.text: LETTER FROM THE FOUNDRY MASTER OF VERRSHOLM TO HIS BROTHER, DATED 2 MAY 1874 (from the family correspondence collection). … the great column for the mariners at Hjarrensund is at last complete and shipped in seven cast segments down the coast. I stood beneath it upon the quay as the final segment was pinned, and watched the men take the measuring chain from the stone footing to the top of the iron. It rises full 38.6 metres above the granite base, the tallest thing I have ever cast in my working life. I write this the very evening of the raising, my hands still black with the work.
